PLANNING COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, SEPTEMBER 18, 2025
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

Alvaro Castillo, Chair  Nicholas Santos, Commissioner
Michele Ware, Vice Chair  Griselda Suarez, Commissioner
Michael Clemson, Commissioner  Jane Templin, Commissioner
Todd Lemmis, Commissioner

  PLANNING COMMISSION IN-PERSON MEETING

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO EMAIL COMMENTS
  TO PLANNINGCOMMISSIONERS@LONGBEACH.GOV

  COMMENTS MAY ALSO BE PROVIDED IN THE ZOOM MEETING USING THE RAISE HAND
  FUNCTION OR BY PRESSING *9 ON YOUR PHONE

  TO JOIN VIA ZOOM, PLEASE DIAL: (213) 338-8477 / MEETING ID: 934 1096 4133
  https://longbeach-gov.zoom.us/j/93410964133

 PLEASE NOTE THE ZOOM MEETING MAY ENCOUNTER TECHNICAL DISRUPTIONS, BUT IN-
  PERSON ACCESS AND PUBLIC COMMENT WILL CONTINUE TO BE AVAILABLE IN
  ACCORDANCE WITH THE BROWN ACT

  PLEASE VIEW THE MEETING FROM YOUR COMPUTER, TABLET, OR SMARTPHONE
  VIA: HTTPS://LONGBEACH.PRIMEGOV.COM/PUBLIC/PORTAL?FROMIFRAME=TRUE

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-56448  Recommendation to receive and file Director’s Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  25-56449  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Planning Commission meeting of
  Thursday, August 7, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  25-56506  Recommendation to certify and adopt the Environmental Impact Report (EIR-01-
  25, State Clearinghouse No. 2024080441) and adopt the Mitigation Monitoring and
  Reporting Program (MMRP) for the Park Tower Student Housing Project;

  Page 1 of 4
   PLANNING COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, SEPTEMBER 18, 2025
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

  Recommend that City Council adopt resolution approving a General Plan
  Amendment (GPA23-001) to change the land use PlaceType of the property at
  5150 East Pacific Coast Highway from Community Commercial (CC) to
  Neighborhood-Serving Center or Corridor - Moderate (NSC-M) PlaceType;

  1. Amend Map LU-7 (PlaceTypes) to convert the project site from Community
  Commercial (CC) to Neighborhood-Serving Center or Corridor - Moderate
  (NSC-M) PlaceType;
  2. Amend Map LU-12 (Neighborhood-Serving Centers and Corridors – Low
  and Moderate PlaceTypes) to include the project site;
  3. Amend Map LU-14 (Community Commercial PlaceType) to exclude the
  project site; and
  4. Amend Map LU-25 (Eastside) to convert the project site from CC to NSC-
  M;

  Recommend that City Council adopt ordinance approving a Zoning Map Change
  (ZCHG23-001) request for the property at 5150 East Pacific Coast Highway, and
  adopt the proposed findings related thereto, to amend the zoning designation from
  Community Commercial Automobile-Oriented (CCA) to Mixed Use 3 (MU-3)
  Zoning District;

  Approve a Site Plan Review (SPR23-001) conditional upon City Council adoption
  of the general plan amendment (GPA23-001) and zone change (ZCHG23-001),
  and adopt the proposed findings and conditions thereto, for the adaptive reuse of a
  seven-story office building into a private dormitory (student housing) with 593 beds,
  a new 728-square foot pavilion building, approximately 22,523 square feet of open
  space, and 364 parking spaces within an existing parking structure located at 5150
  East Pacific Coast Highway in the Community Commercial Automobile-Oriented
  (CCA) Zoning District (pending approval of a zone change to Mixed Use 3 [MU-3]
  Zoning District); and

  Approve a Conditional Use Permit (CUP23-001) conditional upon City Council
  adoption of the general plan amendment (GPA23-001) and zone change
  (ZCHG23-001), and adopt the proposed findings and conditions thereto, to allow
  the operation of a Special Group Residence (private dormitory) in the MU-3 Zoning
  District. (District 3)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  25-56451  Recommendation to accept Categorical Exemption CE-25-087; and

  Approve a Conditional Use Permit (CUP25-008), and adopt the proposed findings
  and conditions of approval related thereto, to allow on-site alcohol beverage sales
  (License Type 41 - On-Sale Beer and Wine - Eating Place) for a proposed pizza
  restaurant with a fixed bar within an existing 4,713-square-foot commercial tenant

  Page 2 of 4
   PLANNING COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, SEPTEMBER 18, 2025
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

  space located at 8105 East Wardlow Road in the Community Commercial
  Automobile Oriented (CCA) Zoning District. (District 4)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Planning Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to
three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Alyssa Campos, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours
prior to the meeting.

https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 570-6101
or cityclerk@longbeach.gov.
